column7: #3041 review: the gRPC auth interceptor never checked models.Session.SetupOnly, so a setup-only session (#3024) that had finished both setup steps but whose revocation had not landed passed every gRPC gate with full access (HTTP refused it with ReauthenticationRequired). The interceptor now applies the HTTP setup gate's rules through enforceGRPCAccountSetup: gRPC has no setup-step RPC, so a setup-only session is refused every RPC (PermissionDenied while steps are owed, Unauthenticated once nothing is owed), and an ordinary session owing both steps is sent to sign in again; its per-session facts come from core.ResolveSessionAuthFacts and a failed read answers Unavailable, audited. The guard walks every RPC the real server registers (GetServiceInfo) with a setup-only session and pins the allowed set (expectedSetupGRPCMethods, empty). Red before: e.g. AuditService/GetAuditLogs answered OK to a setup session that owed nothing.
